learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain knowledge about energy resources, conversion processes, and the importance of energy management.
Students will have knowledge on the selection of energy saving processes in energy-intensive industries.
Students will learn about the effect of recycling on energy saving and topics such as cogeneration.
They will learn about the points to consider in the selection of waste energy recovery systems.
To provide students with the ability to communicate effectively in written and oral forms.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Energy and Energy Saving
Use of New and Renewable Energy Sources in the Chemical Industry
Energy Saving and Management in the Process Industry
Energy Production Processes, Electricity Energy Saving
Efficiency and Environmental Impact, Industrial Energy Efficiency Opportunities
